description: Source code for the xdiff library implementing file differencing algorithms, including Myers' algorithm, with functions for computing diffs, building change scripts, and heuristics for diff presentation.

classes.name: xdpsplit_t
classes.description: Structure used for splitting the diff algorithm's search space.

classes.name: xdlgroup
classes.description: Structure representing a group of changed lines for diff optimization.

methods.name: xdl_split
methods.description: Performs the Myers' diff split algorithm to find the furthest reach point.

methods.name: xdl_recs_cmp
methods.description: Recursively compares record ranges to identify differences.

methods.name: xdl_do_diff
methods.description: Main function to perform diff computation between two files.

methods.name: xdl_add_change
methods.description: Creates a new change record and links it into the change list.

methods.name: recs_match
methods.description: Checks if two records are identical based on minimal perfect hash.

methods.name: get_indent
methods.description: Calculates indentation level of a line, treating tabs as 8 spaces.

methods.name: measure_split
methods.description: Measures characteristics of a hypothetical split position for diff heuristics.

methods.name: score_add_split
methods.description: Calculates a heuristic score for a potential split position.

methods.name: score_cmp
methods.description: Compares two split scores to determine which is better.

methods.name: xdl_build_script
methods.description: Builds an edit script from the diff data.

methods.name: xdl_change_compact
methods.description: Optimizes change groups for better diff presentation.
